name: ChatOllama
description: Self-host an AI chat workspace that connects local Ollama or hosted models to document knowledge bases with cited answers and to stdio or HTTP MCP tools.

skills.name: Knowledge Bases
skills.description: Indexes PDF, Markdown and text documents into collections that the agent searches and cites in its answers.

skills.name: MCP Tools
skills.description: Connects local stdio or remote Streamable HTTP MCP servers and makes their tools available in selected conversations.

skills.name: Model Switching
skills.description: Switches provider and model inside a conversation while keeping its history, across API providers and subscriptions.
